# p10k-rs v0.1.1

Three months past v0.1.0. The prompt now actually **looks** like
Powerlevel10k — full powerline ribbon, multi-line frame, dual-sided
layout, 31 segments — and ships the schema-driven knobs to control
all of it. Closes most of the unfilled-feature requests from the
upstream P10K tracker.

## The headline visual

The factory default `~/.config/p10k-rs/config.toml` is now the
classic P10K "lean" two-sided look out of the box:

```
╭─[ seaburdz@host ][ ~/path ][ main ⇡3 *]
╰─❯                    [ 4s ][ 1↑ ][ 22:32:30 ]
```

— `╭─` / `╰─` frame corners, powerline `` arrows between segments
with different backgrounds, `prompt_char` (`❯`) anchors line 2.
The right side shows `command_execution_time` (3 s+), `background_jobs`,
and `time`. Custom layouts via TOML; the new
`layout.left_top_only` / `right_top_only` keys let any segment opt
into line-1-only behaviour.

## New segments (10 added since v0.1.0)

**Modern version managers** (closing the upstream `#2212` ask):

| Segment | What |
|---|---|
| `mise` | mise (formerly rtx) — env var `$MISE_DATA_DIR`. `rtx` accepted as alias. |
| `fnm` | Fast Node Manager — reads `$FNM_NODE_VERSION`. |
| `pixi` | Prefix's conda alternative — reads `$PIXI_PROJECT_NAME`. |

**Container / cloud context:**

| Segment | What |
|---|---|
| `docker_context` | Active Docker context (env, then `~/.docker/config.json`). Hides on `default`. |
| `ai_host` | Surfaces Claude Code / Aider / Cursor when env signals are detected. |

**Version control beyond git:**

| Segment | What |
|---|---|
| `jj` | Jujutsu working-copy state. **New sibling crate `p10k-rs-jj`.** Renders bookmark or 8-char `change_id` + dirty / conflict markers. |

## Major UI / render features

- **Powerline ribbon** (slice 28). Every segment paints a full background
  block; adjacent segments join with a `` (U+E0B0) arrow whose fg is
  the previous bg and bg is the next — single continuous ribbon.
- **Multi-line frame** (slice 28). `[layout.frame]` ships `╭─` top-corner
  by default; trailing `prompt_char` jumps to a second line with `╰─`.
- **Right prompt / RPROMPT** (slice 33). `layout.right` renders a
  parallel ribbon with left-pointing `` (U+E0B2) arrows. zsh init
  invokes the binary twice per prompt.
- **Transient prompt** (slice 35). zsh `zle-line-finish` widget swaps
  PROMPT for a lone `❯` after each accepted command; scrollback shows
  clean `❯ command` history.
- **Dir truncation** (slices 36, 43). Three strategies: `to_last`,
  `middle`, `to_unique` (filesystem-aware sibling-prefix shortening).
- **Dir not-writable state** (slice 39). Probes `access(2)`; renders
  a yellow band with a padlock icon when the cwd isn't writable.
- **vcs richer markers** (slices 30, 45, 47): `⇡N ⇣N * ! +N ~N ?N ≡N
  <ACTION> @ <tag>` indicators plus detached-HEAD short-SHA fallback.
- **State-aware backgrounds** (slice 34). `status` and `vi_mode` shift
  bg/fg by state; per-state TOML overrides still flow through.
- **Context user@host** (slice 37). `root` / `remote` / `local` states
  with the upstream visibility rules (`$P10K_RS_DEFAULT_USER`,
  `$SSH_*`, EUID 0).
- **Configurable frame corners** (slice 40). `frame.bottom_glyph` joins
  the existing `frame.glyph` / `frame.foreground`.
- **`left_top_only` / `right_top_only`** (slice 57). Any segment can
  opt into line-1-only behaviour, not just `prompt_char`.

## Config-driven gating

Four new per-segment gates take config from inert placeholder to real
wiring:

| Field | What |
|---|---|
| `disabled` | Silently skip a segment by name. |
| `show_in_dir` / `disabled_dir_pattern` | Show only when cwd matches a glob (`globset` 0.4). |
| `show_on_command` | Surface when the last command's head matches a list (zsh `$BUFFER` capture in preexec). |

Plus `[layout.separators]`'s `right` and `subsegment` fields are now
read: `subsegment` joins vcs's indicator chain, `right` separates
RPROMPT segments. Frame-bottom configurable, `left_top_only` /
`right_top_only` shape the multi-line layout, and the factory default
ships everything pre-wired so a no-config install already looks like
Powerlevel10k classic.

## Quality of life

- **`mise` / `rtx` alias** in `build()` so configs using either name
  resolve to the same segment.
- **`os_icon` distro detection** via `/etc/os-release` (Ubuntu /
  Debian / Arch / Fedora / NixOS / Alpine / Gentoo / Manjaro /
  openSUSE) + WSL detection via `/proc/version`. macOS picks the
  Apple glyph; *BSDs pick the daemon.
- **Subprocess timeout** (slice 51). `output_with_deadline` wraps
  `Command::output` with a 500 ms wall-clock budget for the version
  segments — addresses the upstream NordVPN-freeze class of prompt
  hangs.
- **Terminal width via `ioctl(TIOCGWINSZ)`** (slice 29). Replaces the
  `$COLUMNS` env-var read; the ruler glyph now tracks resizes
  without the user having to `export COLUMNS`.
- **`colors = "follow_terminal"`** (slice 53). Best-effort OSC 4
  probe of the terminal's 16-colour palette, falls back to Ansi256
  gracefully.
- **OSC 7 / OSC 133** (slices 46, 55). When `HostKind` detects
  Claude Code / Aider / Cursor, we emit cwd reporting and shell-
  integration markers so the host can parse command boundaries.

## Shell support

- **Bash init** (slice 41) promoted from stub to PROMPT_COMMAND-based
  PS1. Bash gets the prompt; documented gaps for RPROMPT, transient,
  preexec-timing, gitstatusd FIFO.
- **Fish** unchanged from v0.1.0.
- **Zsh** got the slice 33 / 35 / 55 wiring for RPROMPT, transient
  widgets, and OSC 133 boundary markers.

## Documentation

mdBook site bootstrapped at `docs/` with chapters covering quickstart,
configuration, segments, theming, architecture (crate layout, render
pipeline, security model), and a full schema reference. A GitHub Pages
workflow publishes on every push to `main`. Closes upstream `#1112`
(30 comments — "is there a docs page?").

## Known gaps

- **`show_on_command` semantic** captures the *last* command, not the
  upcoming one — the cheap precmd path. A ZLE `line-pre-redraw`
  widget for true upcoming semantics is future work.
- **Bash** can't host RPROMPT, transient, or instant-prompt cache —
  zsh-specific machinery.
- **vcs `*` marker stays hardcoded red** because the single-fg-per-state
  schema can't distinguish branch from marker. A future
  `marker_foreground` field is on the list.
- **The `[ai]` config block** is partially wired: detection and OSC
  emission work; richer per-host metadata (context tokens, model
  name) lands later.

## Upgrade

```bash
./install.sh
```

or

```bash
cargo install --path crates/p10k-rs --force
```

Existing TOML configs continue to work unchanged. The factory default
shifts from a 5-segment single-line layout to the two-sided P10K-classic
layout — drop a `~/.config/p10k-rs/config.toml` with your previous
`layout.left` to keep the old shape.
